name: Hydrocortisone Cream/Ointment 1%
dosing: Apply thinly to affected area OD-BD. Use ointment for dry skin, cream for moist
contraindications: Untreated infection, rosacea, acne, perioral dermatitis
pregnancy: Safe - use potent steroids with caution
sideEffects: Skin atrophy, striae, telangiectasia (prolonged use), rarely systemic absorption
clinicalPearls: Available OTC. Mild steroid - safe for face/flexures. Fingertip unit (FTU) dosing. Can use in children
indication: Mild eczema, insect bites, contact dermatitis, mild inflammatory skin conditions
